```html [Web Component]
<script type="module">
  import '@zeus-web/chat/wc/auto'
</script>

<zw-chat>
  <zw-chat-thread slot="thread">
    <zw-chat-message role="assistant"> How can I help? </zw-chat-message>
  </zw-chat-thread>
  <zw-chat-composer slot="composer"></zw-chat-composer>
</zw-chat>
```

```tsx [React]
import {
  Chat,
  ChatComposer,
  ChatMessage,
  ChatThread,
} from '@zeus-web/chat/react'

export function SupportChat() {
  return (
    <Chat
      thread={
        <ChatThread>
          <ChatMessage role="assistant">How can I help?</ChatMessage>
        </ChatThread>
      }
      composer={<ChatComposer />}
    />
  )
}
```

```vue [Vue]

import { Chat, ChatComposer, ChatMessage, ChatThread } from '@zeus-web/chat/vue'
</script>

<template>

    <template #thread>
      <ChatThread>
        <ChatMessage role="assistant">How can I help?</ChatMessage>
      </ChatThread>
    </template>
    <template #composer>
      <ChatComposer />
    </template>
  </Chat>
</template>
```
